expose-command: <EXPOSE_COMMAND: shell command that establishes the requested temporary API execution surface; leave empty when not supported>
expose-teardown-command: <EXPOSE_TEARDOWN_COMMAND: shell command that reverses the temporary exposure; leave empty only when expose-command is empty>
augment-command: <AUGMENT_COMMAND: shell command that applies a requested reversible host augmentation; leave empty when not supported>
augment-teardown-command: <AUGMENT_TEARDOWN_COMMAND: shell command that reverses the host augmentation; leave empty only when augment-command is empty>
seed-command: <SEED_COMMAND: shell command that transactionally seeds requested temporary persistence state; leave empty when not supported>
seed-teardown-command: <SEED_TEARDOWN_COMMAND: shell command that removes or rolls back the seed; leave empty only when seed-command is empty>
fixture-command: <FIXTURE_COMMAND: shell command that creates requested synthetic fixture data or files; leave empty when not supported>
fixture-teardown-command: <FIXTURE_TEARDOWN_COMMAND: shell command that removes the synthetic fixture; leave empty only when fixture-command is empty>
health-command: <HEALTH_COMMAND: shell command that verifies the prepared host before execution; leave empty to skip>
